reported.quote: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 3,091 crore, registering a sequential growth of 19% and year-on-year growth of 61%.
EBITDA reached a record INR  643 crore, growing at 187% year-on-year and 16% quarter-on-quarter with EBITDA margin sustained at 21%.
PBT increased to INR 543 crore, while PAT reached INR 398 crore, representing sequential growth of 16% and 15%, respectively.
For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue stood at INR 5,682 crore registering 48% year-on-year growth.
EBITDA increased 173% to INR 1,197 crore with margins expanding to 21% compared with approximately 11% in corresponding period last year.
Phenolics delivered highest ever quarterly revenue of INR 2,291 crore, an increase of 29% sequentially and 72% year-on-year.
EBIT increased to INR 515 crore, up 23% quarter-on-quarter, with EBIT margin of approximately 22%.
For H1 FY27, the segment recorded revenue of INR 4,066 crore and EBIT of INR 933 crore.
